an6.44:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] atha kho āyasmā ānando pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena migasālāya upāsikāya nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an6.44:1.2: atha kho migasālā upāsikā yenāyasmā ānando, tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho migasālā upāsikā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
an6.44:2.1: kathaṃ kathaṃ nāmāyaṃ bhante ānanda, bhagavatā dhammo desito aññeyyo, yatra hi nāma brahmacārī ca abrahmacārī ca ubho samasamagatikā bhavissanti abhisamparāyaṃ?
an6.44:2.2: pitā me bhante purāṇo brahmacārī ahosi ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
an6.44:2.3: so kālakato. bhagavatā vyākato. “sakadāgāmī satto tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapannoti.”
an6.44:2.4: petteyyopi me bhante isidatto abrahmacārī ahosi sadārasantuṭṭho.
an6.44:2.5: sopi kālakato. bhagavatā vyākato: “sakadāgāmi satto tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapanno”ti.
an6.44:2.6: kathaṃ kathaṃ nāmāyaṃ bhante ānanda, bhagavatā dhammo desito aññeyyo, yatra hi nāma brahmacārī ca abrahmacārī ca ubho samasamagatikā bhavissanti abhisamparāyanti?
an6.44:2.7: evaṃ kho panetaṃ bhagini bhagavatā vyākatanti.
an6.44:3.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando migasālāya upāsikāya nivesane piṇḍapātaṃ gahetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
an6.44:3.2: atha kho āyasmā ānando pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an6.44:4.1: idhāhaṃ bhante pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena migasālāya upāsikāya nivesanaṃ, tenupasaṅkamiṃ. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdiṃ.
an6.44:4.2: atha kho bhante migasālā upāsikā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho bhante migasālā upāsikā maṃ etadavoca:
an6.44:4.3: kathaṃ kathaṃ nāmāya bhante ānanda, bhagavatā dhammo desito aññeyyo, yatra hi nāma brahmacārī ca abrahmacārī ca ubho samasamagatikā bhavissanti abhisamparāyaṃ.
an6.44:4.4: pitā me bhante purāṇo brahmacārī ahosi ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
an6.44:4.5: so kālakato. bhagavatā vyākato: sakadāgāmī satto tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapannoti.
an6.44:4.6: petteyyopi me bhante isidatto abrahmacārī ahosi sadārasantuṭṭho.
an6.44:4.7: sopi kālakato. bhagavatā vyākato: sakadāgāmī satto tusitaṃ kāyaṃ upapannoti.
an6.44:4.8: kathaṃ kathaṃ nāmāyaṃ bhante ānanda bhagavatā dhammo desito aññeyyo, yatra hi nāma brahmacārīca abrahmacārī ca ubho samasamagatikā bhavissanti abhisamparāyanti?
an6.44:4.9: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ bhante migasālaṃ upāsikaṃ etadavocaṃ:
an6.44:4.10: evaṃ kho panetaṃ bhagini bhagavatā byākatanti.
an6.44:5.1: kā cānanda migasālā upāsikā bālā abyattā ambakā ambakapaññā? ke ca purisapuggalaparopariyañāṇe?
an6.44:5.2: chayime ānanda puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ
an6.44:6.2: idhānanda ekacco puggalo sorato hoti sukhasaṃvāso. abhinandanti sabrahmacārī ekattavāsena.
an6.44:6.3: tassa savaṇenapi akataṃ hoti, bāhusaccenapi akataṃ hoti, diṭṭhiyāpi appaṭividdhaṃ hoti, sāmayikampi vimuttiṃ na labhati.
an6.44:6.4: so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā hānāya pareti no visesāya, hānagāmīyeva hoti no visesagāmī. (1)
an6.44:7.1: idhānanda ekacco puggalo sorato hoti sukhasaṃvāso. abhinandanti sabrahmacārī ekattavāsena.
an6.44:7.2: tassa savaṇenapi kataṃ hoti. bāhusaccenapi kataṃ hoti. diṭṭhiyāpi suppaṭividdhaṃ. hoti. sāmayikampi vimuttiṃ labhati.
an6.44:7.3: so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā visesāya pareti no hānāya. visesagāmīyeva hoti no hānagāmī. (2)
an6.44:8.2: imassapi teva dhammā, aparassapi teva dhammā. kasmā tesaṃ eko hīno, eko paṇītoti.
an6.44:8.3: taṃ hi tesaṃ ānanda hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
an6.44:9.1: tatrānanda yvāyaṃ puggalo sorato. hoti sukhasaṃvāso. abhinandanti sabrahmacārī ekattavāsena. tassa savaṇenapi kataṃ hoti. bāhusaccenapi kataṃ hoti. diṭṭhiyāpi suppaṭividdhaṃ hoti. sāmayikampi vimuttiṃ labhati.
an6.44:9.2: ayampi ānanda puggalo amunā purimena puggalena abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
an6.44:9.6: tasmātiha ānanda mā puggalesu pamāṇakā ahuvattha.
an6.44:9.9: ahaṃ vā ānanda puggalesu pamāṇaṃ gaṇheyyaṃ yo vā panassa mādiso.
an6.44:10.1: idha panānanda ekaccassa puggalassa kodhamāno adhigato hoti samayena samayañcassa lobhadhammā uppajjanti.
an6.44:10.2: tassa savaṇenapi akataṃ hoti. bāhusaccenapi akataṃ hoti. diṭṭhiyāpi appaṭividdhaṃ hoti. sāmayikampi vimuttiṃ na labhati.
an6.44:10.3: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā hānāya pareti, no visesāya, hānagāmīyeva hoti, no visesagāmī. (3)
an6.44:11.1: idha panānanda ekaccassa puggalassa kodhamāno adhigato hoti. samayena samayañcassa lobhadhammā uppajjanti.
an6.44:13.1: idha panānanda ekaccassa puggalassa kodhamāno adhigato hoti. samayena samayañcassa vacīsaṃsārā uppajjanti.
an6.44:13.2: tassa savaṇenapi akataṃ hoti. bāhusaccenapi akataṃ hoti. diṭṭhiyāpi appaṭividdhaṃ hoti. sāmayikampi vimuttiṃ na labhati.
an6.44:13.3: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā hānāya pareti no visesāya, hānagāmīyeva hoti no visesagāmī. (5)
an6.44:14.1: idha panānanda ekaccassa puggalassa kodhamāno adhigato hoti. samayena samayañcassa vacīsaṃsārā uppajjanti.
an6.44:14.2: tassa savaṇenapi kataṃ hoti bāhusaccenapi kataṃ hoti. diṭṭhiyāpi paṭividdhaṃ hoti. sāmayikampi vimuttiṃ labhati.
an6.44:14.3: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā visesāya pareti no hānāya. visesagāmīyeva hoti, no hānagāmī. (6)
an6.44:15.2: imassapi teva dhammā, aparassapi teva dhammā. kasmā tesaṃ eko hīno, eko paṇītoti?
an6.44:15.3: taṃ hi tesaṃ ānanda hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
an6.44:16.1: tatrānanda yassa puggalassa kodhamāno adhigato hoti. samayena samayañcassa vacīsaṃsārā uppajjantī. tassa savaṇenapi kataṃ hoti bāhusaccenapi kataṃ hoti. diṭṭhiyāpi suppaṭividdhaṃ hoti. sāmayikampi vimuttiṃ labhati.
an6.44:16.2: ayaṃ ānanda puggalo amunā purimena puggalena abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
an6.44:16.6: tasmātiha ānanda mā puggalesu pamāṇakā ahuvattha,
an6.44:16.9: ahaṃ vā ānanda puggalesu pamāṇaṃ gaṇheyyaṃ, yo vā panassa mādiso.
an6.44:17.1: kā cānanda migasālā upāsikā bālā avyattā ambakā ambakapaññā? ke ca purisapuggalaparopariyañāṇe?
an6.44:17.2: ime kho ānanda cha puggalā santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
an6.44:18.1: yathārūpena ānanda sīlena purāṇo samannāgato ahosi, tathārūpena sīlena isidatto samannāgato abhavissa, nayidha purāṇo isidattassa gatimpi aññassa.
an6.44:18.2: yathārūpāya ca ānanda paññāya isidatto samannāgato ahosi. tathārūpāya paññāya purāṇo samannāgato abhavissa, nayidha isidatto purāṇassa gatimpi aññassa.
an6.44:18.3: iti kho ānanda ime puggalā ubho ekaṅgahīnāti.
